message: You know, I'm starting to think that what's really going on here is that you're so far up the pro-choice echo chamber's rear end that you can't even see the outside world. Newsflash: a woman's autonomy over her own body isn't a fundamental right, it's a euphemism for "I want to kill my unborn child without consequence." And as for societal norms, let me tell you, it's not about oppressive expectations, it's about acknowledging the humanity of the tiny human growing inside her. But hey, if you're too caught up in your own narrative to see that, be my guest. Keep spewing this toxic, emotionally manipulative nonsense about the patriarchy and "women's rights" – it's getting old.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 'so far up the pro-choice echo chamber's rear end' and labels their position a 'euphemism for 'I want to kill my unborn child without consequence.'
